title: [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDESTORY: THUNDER IN THE AZURE DREAM OPEN
lines: 01 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] SIDESTORY: THUNDER IN THE AZURE DREAM OPEN
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - December 7, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10

DETAILS: Thunder in the Azure Dream event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing Hunter's Notes and event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
Event Stages will open in 2 phases:
Phase 1 [Hunting the Azure Thunder]
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - November 30, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Phase 2 [Treading on Dreams]
DURATION: November 23, 16:00 - November 30, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Hunter's Notes]
DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain rewards by clearing event stages to unlock all Special Info.
REWARDS: Event Furniture
[ Mandate of the General ]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Mandate of the General] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★: Rhodes Island Recon], Module Materials, Melding Materials, etc.
[ Suponosuke's Workshop ]
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - December 7, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain Melding Materials by clearing event stages and completing [Mandate of the General]. Melding Materials can be used to redeem items from [Suponosuke's Workshop].
REWARDS: Rhodes Island Recon's Tokens, 'Houei Living Room' Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permits, Module Materials, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
02 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] LIMITED HEADHUNTING OPEN – HUNTERS OF THE UMBRAL WILDS
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - November 30, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited Headhunting, [Hunters of the Umbral Wilds], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Violet Mizutsune Orchid
★★★★★: Zinogre S Catapult
NOTE:
- [Hunters of the Umbral Wilds] Headhunting is a [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting].

- Operators Violet Mizutsune Orchid and Zinogre S Catapult are the Limited Headhunting Operators of [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting]. They can ONLY be obtained while [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting] is available and is NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- In [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting], Operator Violet Mizutsune Orchid is guaranteed every 120 pulls, and the count resets each time Operator Violet Mizutsune Orchid is obtained.

- In [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting], if the current rate-up 5★ Operator is not obtained within the first 50 headhunting attempts, the next 5★ Operator obtained is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 5★ Operator.
- Please refer to the official notice of this Limited Headhunting for more details.
03 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] LIMITED LOGIN EVENT OPEN
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - November 30, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can log in for 10 days to receive generous rewards, including: Song of the Bow, Leap to the Sky Headhunting Permit * 2, Event Icon, Event Furniture, Orundum, and more.
Day 1: Emergency Sanity Concentrate * 1, Song of the Bow, Leap to the Sky Headhunting Permit * 1
Day 2: Data Supplement Stick * 10, Orundum * 200
Day 3: Tactical Battle Record * 20, Expedited Plan * 5
Day 4: Furniture Part * 300, Orundum * 200
Day 5: Pure Gold * 20, Icon 'Hunter's Barbecue' * 1
Day 6: Strategic Battle Record * 10, Furniture 'Open Flame BBQ Spit' * 1
Day 7: LMD * 30000, Orundum * 200
Day 8: Data Supplement Instrument * 3, Song of the Bow, Leap to the Sky Headhunting Permit * 1
Day 9: Recruitment Permit * 5, Furniture 'Tough Alloy Supply Box' * 1
Day 10: Skill Summary - 3 * 8, Module Data Block * 1
NOTE:
- Song of the Bow, Leap to the Sky Headhunting Permit can only be used to perform a 10-roll in [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting] Limited Headhunting.
- Song of the Bow, Leap to the Sky Headhunting Permit expires at: November 30, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
- Please refer to the in-game info for the expiration time of the Emergency Sanity Concentrate from this event.
04 [ARKNIGHTS X MONSTER HUNTER] NEW OPERATORS NOW AVAILABLE
The following Operators will be added to the game:
★★★★★★: Violet Mizutsune Orchid
★★★★★: Zinogre S Catapult
★: Rhodes Island Recon
NOTE:

- Operator Rhodes Island Recon is currently ONLY available to be obtained from the event Thunder in the Azure Dream, and is NOT available in the Limited Headhunting [Hunters of the Umbral Wilds], or any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- New Operators Violet Mizutsune Orchid and Zinogre S Catapult are ONLY available from [Phantasmal Pursuit Headhunting], and are NOT available in any Standard Headhunting or Kernel Headhunting.
- Violet Mizutsune Orchid, Zinogre S Catapult and Rhodes Island Recon will gain more trust in the event stages during the event.

11 LIMITED-TIME PACKS AVAILABLE
DURATION: November 16, 08:00 - December 14, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the following packs will be available from the Store for a limited time.
[Hunter Special Training Pack]
CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Invitation Letter * 1, Senior Operator Training Invitation Letter * 2

Top Operator Training Invitation Letter: You can promote a hired 6-star Operator to Elite 2 Lv.1 (effective for 6-star Operators under Elite 2 Lv.1). Upgrade materials already spent will not be returned.
[Hunter Arts Pack]
CONTENTS: Top Operator Training Apparatus * 1, Senior Operator Training Apparatus * 2
Top Operator Training Apparatus: Use to level up a 6-star Operator who has been promoted to Elite 2 directly to Elite 2, Level 90. Resources already invested will not be returned after usage.

CONTENTS: Originite Prime * 16, LMD * 700000

CONTENTS: Orundum * 5000, Chip Catalyst * 2, LMD * 100000, Skill Summary - 1 * 80, Module Data Block * 2

◆ Players who have previously purchased the [Roka Voyager Memorial Pack] will not be able to purchase it again.
[Strike Camp Hunt Pack]
